messages:
Priya (CS): Kickoff for Clearwell Diagnostics onboarding — want to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a high-level 30/60/90 timeline. Who's joining from their side?
Sofia (Clearwell): Hi all — I'm Sofia (product lead). Joining: Raj (infra) and Lina (devops). Excited to get started.
Emma (CS): Thanks Sofia — can you confirm target go-live? Also any compliance constraints we should pre-flag?
Sofia (Clearwell): Target go-live is mid-May (about 8 weeks). We need HIPAA PII handling and an internal SOC review in week 5.
Jordan (SE): Noted. Technical checklist from our side: SSO (SAML), SCIM for user provisioning, webhook endpoints, and a staging dataset with representative traffic.
Mike (TPM): Proposed milestones: Week 1: discovery + SSO test, Week 2-3: infra + staging, Week 4: feature enablement, Week 5: SOC review & freeze, Week 6-7: UAT, Week 8: cutover. Can we confirm resource availability?
Sofia (Clearwell): Raj can do the SSO test in week 1. Lina will help with staging in weeks 2-3.
Priya (CS): Success criteria (suggestion): 1) End-to-end inference flow in staging with <150ms p95 latencies, 2) SSO working for 100% of test users, 3) Key eval prompts pass quality gate (statistical pass), 4) Runbook & rollback tested. Thoughts?
Emma (CS): Add: cost-budget guardrail configured in Console and alerts for token-rate spikes.
Jordan (SE): For latency target we need sample payload size and concurrency. Sofia, what QPS should staging mimic?
Sofia (Clearwell): Aim for 50rps peak in staging, average 10rps. Payloads will be 200-600 tokens typical.
Jordan (SE): Great — I'll add continuous batching config and a KV cache suggestion.
onboard-bot: Meeting scheduled: Clearwell Onboard Kickoff — Thu 2024-03-14 15:00 PDT (calendar invitation sent).
Mike (TPM): Risks flagged: 1) SOC review timeline could slip (impacts go-live), 2) Trial credits expire in 6 weeks unless we convert to Dedicated, 3) Data residency note (they want EU backups). Need owners.
Priya (CS): Assigning owners: SOC review owner = Sofia, Trial/contract owner = Mike (I'll loop Sales), EU backup owner = Raj.
Sofia (Clearwell): A couple asks — can we get an async walkthrough video of the Console + a short playbook for incident escalation?
Emma (CS): Yes — we'll post a 10-min Console explainer recording and a 1-page escalation flow doc to the shared drive by EOD Friday.
Jordan (SE): Action: I'll spin up a staging model variant with quantization suggestion and share perf numbers by next Wed.
Priya (CS): Action: Priya to run weekly 30-min standups (Wed 10am PT) until cutover. Would that cadence work for everyone?
Sofia (Clearwell): Yes that's fine.
Mike (TPM): Noted next steps + dependencies in the thread. I'll create a timeline RFC in the shared doc and tag owners.
Emma (CS): Also asking for a short prompt set from Clearwell (10-20 examples) to run quality checks — Sofia can you share?
Sofia (Clearwell): Will do — sending a first batch after this meeting.
Priya (CS): Closing notes: primary KPIs = latency p95, quality pass rate, SSO success. Renewal risk note: trial credit expiry could be a blocker; Sales follow-up required to prevent churn. :thumbsup:
Mike (TPM): +1 — I'll ping Sales.
Sofia (Clearwell): Thanks everyone — looking forward to kickoff.
Emma (CS): Thanks team :raised_hands:
Priya (CS): Logged actions: meeting on Thu, 30-min weekly cadence, owners assigned, docs + recording by Fri. We'll update the runbook after first staging run.
